title: Switch
description: The smart traffic cop of your LAN
tagline: The smart traffic cop of your LAN

sections.title: What a Switch Does
sections.body: A switch connects many devices inside one LAN. It is smart: instead of shouting every message to everyone, it delivers each frame only to the port of the device it is meant for. Every port gets its own private lane, so many devices can talk at the same time with no collisions.

sections.title: How It Learns Who Lives Where
sections.body: The switch keeps a little notebook called the MAC address table. When a frame arrives it: (1) writes down the sender MAC + which port it came in, (2) checks the destination MAC.
points: Destination known → forward out just that ONE port.
Destination unknown or broadcast → flood out all other ports.
